diane (Revenue): Heads-up: during the month-end deferred schedule check I found a $18,760 gap tied to CloudVantage INV-90021. The billing pipeline applied a refund/promo treatment instead of treating it as vendor-funded prepay (experiment flag 'usage-surge' leaked). Can we triage before we lock the pack? cc mark, rana

close-bot: Vendor invoice received: INV-90021 (CloudVantage). Amount: $18,760. Posted 2026-04-12 09:14 UTC.

mark (Billing): I pulled the event. Invoice lines had promo_token=true so mapping set type=refund_credit which our pipeline posts as contra-revenue. For CloudVantage vendor prepayments we should map to prepaid_hosting. System auto-posted a contra of $1,876 in the draft run.

diane (Revenue): That's the problem. Full amount should be deferred and amortized over 6 months per contract CV-112. Monthly amort = $3,126.67. Current over-recognition = $1,876. Need a correcting JE and the mapping fix.

rana (Controller): If it's still in draft we can correct now. Please prepare workpaper + suggested JE. I need invoice PDF, billing export, mapping snapshot, and contract to sign off.

mark (Billing): Proposed correcting entries:

```
Reversing JE - April 2026 (draft)
Dr Contra-Revenue 1,876
Cr Accounts Payable 1,876
Memo: Reverse auto-applied refund_credit for CloudVantage INV-90021 (mis-map)

Establish deferred balance
Dr Accounts Payable 18,760
Cr Deferred Revenue 18,760
Memo: Record vendor-funded prepay (CloudVantage INV-90021) amort 6 months
```

diane (Revenue): Uploaded docs to the workpaper: invoice https://files.redwood/INV-90021.pdf, billing export https://files.redwood/billing/90021-export.csv, mapping snapshot: https://docs.redwood/pricing/mapping-2026-04-11, contract CV-112 (6-month) linked in the WP. Short root-cause note added: experiment "usage-surge" incorrectly set promo_token on vendor billing feed.

mark (Billing): I'll open a mapping PR to treat vendor=CloudVantage + promo_token=true + sku contains "commit" => prepaid_hosting. PR link: https://git.redwood/billing/pulls/312. Workpaper created: WP-INV-90021-cloudvantage-fix.

elena (VP Finance): Reviewed the summary. Approve the reversing JE + deferral establishment for this close. Rana please post the JE once docs attached and cc me. Also add a control action: validate experiment toggles against vendor mapping rules during billing cutoffs.

rana (Controller): I have the attachments. Approving the JE. Will post before EOD and update the deferred revenue schedule. I'll tag the WP and include the PR link for audit.

diane (Revenue): Thanks. Quick ask: mark, can you run a 90-day scan for other CloudVantage invoices where promo_token=true? If any, drop CSV into the WP so we can batch-review.

mark (Billing): Running now. Preliminary scan shows INV-89980 flagged but already treated correctly (no promo_token). Only 90021 had the leaked flag in this window. I'll attach results to WP.

diane (Revenue): Closing loop. After JE posts, Rana, please confirm the deferred schedule reflects the $18,760 reclass and send an updated close pack. I'll follow up after PR merges with a brief RCA note. :memo:
